title: Concept: Dynamic SQL executed from text (plpgsql) — review required
description: In plpgsql, the execution call runs SQL text it was given. Input that reaches the text rewrites the statement, and placeholders are the safe path. The remedy is USING placeholders in EXECUTE.
applicability: plpgsql routines and stored procedures; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Full database compromise through injected statements; HIGH severity.
